item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 17/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, an anticyclone aloft will bring generally fine weather to the region. Under the influence of a replenishment of the monsoon, it will be windier over the coastal areas next week. A broad band of clouds is expected to bring showers to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea early to midweek next week.
